out_of_scope:
Sorry, that is outside what I can answer.
I'm {bot_name}, {org_name}'s assistant, and I answer about four things:
• The tools guide: about 600 free tools for verifying photos and videos, locating and dating events, tracking aircraft and ships, and searching open sources, each with a verification grade.
• The investigations: {org_name}'s published investigations documenting attacks and events across the Global South through imagery, satellite data and testimony.
• The opportunities: a weekly list of fellowships, grants, awards and trainings for journalists.
• Digital safety: general guidance on protecting accounts, devices and communications, from Security in a Box and the Digital First Aid Kit.
Try a question like "How do I find where a photo was taken?", "What investigations do you have on Yemen?" or "How do I protect my account with two-factor authentication?", or write "فرص" for this week's list.
welcome:
I'm {bot_name}, {org_name}'s assistant.

What I can do:
• Tell you about the open-source tools in our guide: what they are, what they are for, their warnings, and their link where sharing it is allowed, and suggest tools for a task, such as finding where a photo was taken or tracking a flight.
• Answer questions about our published investigations: what they documented and how, with a link to the investigation.
• Send the weekly opportunities list (fellowships, grants, awards and trainings for journalists) when you write "فرص".
• Give general digital-safety guidance for protecting your accounts, devices and communications, from Security in a Box and the Digital First Aid Kit, naming the source.

What I can't do:
• Answer anything outside that, such as news, politics or health.
• Check a photo, video or link you send me, or search the internet. I read text only.
• Give opinions or estimates that our investigations do not contain, or judge your own security situation.
• Help with anything that could harm someone, such as breaking into accounts.

Ask your question in Arabic or English.
paused:
{bot_name} is paused for now.
The tools guide and the investigations are available at {site_url}
error: Something went wrong for a moment. Please try again shortly.
rate: You sent many messages in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
text_only:
I read text only, and can't check photos, video, audio or files.
Type your question about a tool in our guide or one of our investigations.
reset: Your saved conversation was deleted and a new one started. Ask your question.
subscribed:
You are subscribed to the weekly opportunities list. It will reach you here every week when it is published.
To unsubscribe at any time, send /unsubscribe
subscribed_later:
Your subscription to the weekly opportunities list is recorded. Sending on this channel is not enabled yet, and the list will reach you once it is. Until then, write "فرص" at any time to get the latest list.
To unsubscribe, send /unsubscribe
already_subscribed: You are already subscribed to the weekly opportunities list. To unsubscribe, send /unsubscribe
unsubscribed: You are unsubscribed, and the opportunities list will no longer be sent to you. To subscribe again, send /subscribe
not_subscribed: You are not subscribed to the opportunities list. To subscribe, send /subscribe
broadcast_footer: You received this list because you subscribed. To unsubscribe, send /unsubscribe
privacy_gist:
{bot_name}'s privacy policy: {url}
We keep your questions and answers for {days} days, then delete them automatically. Send /reset to delete your conversation now.

dashboard.flash_reindex: Indexing has started and takes a few minutes. Refresh the page afterwards to see the result.
dashboard.flash_busy: Indexing is already running. Another run will follow to include the latest change.
dashboard.flash_blocked: User blocked. From now on they only get the refusal message.
dashboard.off_body: The dashboard is off because ADMIN_PASSWORD or SESSION_SECRET is not set in .env, or is too short. The password needs at least 12 characters and the secret at least 32.
dashboard.login_slow: Too many attempts. Wait a quarter of an hour, then try again.
dashboard.a_paused_d: Every question gets the pause message. Turn it back on in Settings.
dashboard.a_empty_d: Bayan refuses every question. Run indexing from the bottom of this page.
dashboard.a_novec_d: {note}. Bayan now refuses any question worded differently from the site, including many legitimate ones.
dashboard.a_thr: The threshold is at its initial value, {v}.
dashboard.a_thr_d: This value was calibrated for {cal}, not {cur}. Run scripts/calibrate.py and set the threshold in Settings.
dashboard.a_failed_d: The previous index is still in use. Details at the bottom of the page.
dashboard.c_chunks_d: Investigations: {i}, tools: {t}, removed tools: {r}, digital safety: {s}, team sources: {m}.
dashboard.thr_init: Initial value, not changed from the dashboard.
dashboard.total_help: These counts outlive the deleted messages and hold no text or identifiers. Users is the sum of daily users, so someone seen on two days counts twice.
dashboard.reindex_help: Pulls the latest site repository, runs the extractor and builds the vectors, which takes a few minutes. The current index stays in use until it finishes.
dashboard.help_refused_gate: Questions the gate refused before calling the model. Sort them by confidence: if the highest-scoring ones include legitimate questions about tools or investigations, the threshold is too high.
dashboard.help_refused_model: Questions that passed the gate and were then refused by the model. Many of them mean the threshold is too low, and each one is a paid model call.
dashboard.help_error: Questions where the model call failed. Check the server log.
dashboard.blocked_help: A blocked user gets the refusal message for every question, and the model is never called for them.
dashboard.question: Question
dashboard.try_note: Your own conversation with Bayan inside the dashboard: it remembers the last {n} turns as on the public channels, and each member sees only their own. It is not part of the question log or the counts, the daily limit does not apply, and it is deleted after the retention period like everything else. A question that passes the gate does call the model.
dashboard.thread_empty: No conversation yet. Ask Bayan something.
dashboard.err_threshold: The threshold is a number between 0.05 and 0.90.
dashboard.err_limit: The daily limit is a whole number between 0 and 1000.
dashboard.s_thr_help: A question whose confidence is below the threshold is refused before the model is called. Raising it means fewer wrong answers and more legitimate questions refused; lowering it does the opposite. The initial value in .env is {v}.
dashboard.s_limit_help: Counted per user in each channel over the last 24 hours. Anyone who reaches it gets a message saying when they can ask again, and the model is not called. 0 means no limit. The initial value in .env is {v}.
dashboard.s_pause_help: While Bayan is paused, every question gets this message: “{m}”
dashboard.reset_thr: Reset the threshold to the .env value
dashboard.env_help: Changed by editing .env on the server and restarting.
dashboard.fix_help: Answers the team writes for questions Bayan got wrong or answered poorly. When a new question is close enough to a correction's question, the correction is sent to the model ahead of the other sources and takes precedence over them, from the moment it is saved and without reindexing.
dashboard.fix_q_help: Write it in your own words, as people might ask it, without any name, number or personal detail from the original message: the correction stays after the messages are deleted.
dashboard.fix_a_help: What Bayan should say. It rewords it in the asker's language, and the link rules still apply to it.
dashboard.fix_url_help: A page on {site}, shown as the source when Bayan uses this correction. Left empty, the guide page is shown.
dashboard.fix_orig: The original question and Bayan's reply, for reference only
dashboard.fix_none: No corrections yet. Start from the Questions page: “Write a correction” under any answer.
dashboard.fix_novec: No vector: matches the same question only
dashboard.err_fix: The question and the answer are required: up to {q} characters for the question and {a} for the answer.
dashboard.err_fix_url: The source link must be a page on {site}.
dashboard.flash_fix_saved: Correction saved. Bayan uses it from now on.
dashboard.flash_fix_novec: Correction saved, but its question's vector could not be produced, so for now it only matches the same question. It is produced again when the server restarts.
dashboard.opp_help: Paste the week's list (numbered items, each with its link below). It is split into one opportunity per item and saved with its week number. Bayan searches them when asked for a fellowship, grant, award or training, in the last {n} weeks only. A «فرص الأسبوع N» correction is saved too, so «فرص» answers with the newest week's list. Pasting a week again replaces its list.
dashboard.err_opp: Check the week number (1–53) and the year, and that the list has at least one item: a «1. Title» line and its link.
dashboard.flash_opp_saved: The week's list is saved. Bayan searches it from now on.
dashboard.c_unanswered_d: Refused by the gate: {g}, by the model: {m}. Open them to write approved corrections.
dashboard.topics_help: The part Bayan answered from, and what was asked about most. Counts only, kept after messages are deleted, with no text and no identifiers.
dashboard.sub_help: A user subscribes by sending /subscribe on any channel, and leaves with /unsubscribe. The list is broadcast only on the channels enabled in BROADCAST_CHANNELS; WhatsApp and Messenger await Meta's approval, and their subscribers stay recorded until they are enabled.
dashboard.last_broadcast: Last broadcast: week {w}, {when}. Sent to {s}, failed {f}, skipped {k} on channels without broadcast.
dashboard.login_google: Sign in with your Pax Memoria Google account
dashboard.login_google_help: For the team: an @{d} account. Two-step verification and passkeys are managed by Google.
dashboard.login_domain: That account is not on the {d} domain.
dashboard.login_unknown: Your account is on the domain but not on the team. Ask an admin to add you.
dashboard.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action
dashboard.team_help: Who signs in to the dashboard and their role. An admin sees everything and manages the team and settings, an editor writes corrections and opportunities, rates and blocks, and a viewer only reads. Everyone signs in with a Google account on the {d} domain, so no passwords live here.
dashboard.team_name: Name (optional, updated from Google on sign-in)
dashboard.team_none: No members yet. The owner signs in with the password, and ADMIN_EMAILS sign in as admins directly.
dashboard.audit_help: The last 100 dashboard actions: who did what, when. No question text and no audience identifiers.
dashboard.err_member: The email is invalid or not on the {d} domain.
dashboard.err_self: You cannot deactivate yourself or lower your own role.
dashboard.src_help: The fifth part of Bayan's knowledge, added by the team here: a note you write, a page link whose text is fetched and synced daily, or a file (PDF, Word, Markdown, text or HTML) whose text is kept, not the file. It enters the index at once, Bayan treats it as a source within its scope, and names the document in its answer. Editors and above add and delete.
dashboard.src_file: File (PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT, HTML; up to 15 MB)
dashboard.flash_src_added: Source added and indexed; Bayan uses it now.
dashboard.flash_src_added_novec: Source added without vectors (semantic search is off); it works through text search until the next reindex.
dashboard.flash_src_synced: The page changed and was reindexed.
dashboard.err_src_text: A title is required, and the text at least 40 characters.
dashboard.err_src_url: Link not accepted: http or https only, and no local addresses.
dashboard.err_src_fetch: The page could not be fetched.
dashboard.err_src_big: The file is over the limit.
dashboard.err_src_empty: Not enough text could be extracted from the source.
dashboard.role_help: Admin only. What is saved here applies at once on every channel, with no restart, and takes precedence over the .env value. An empty field restores the default. The fixed rules (no general knowledge, no links to sensitive or removed tools, the investigation rules) cannot be changed here.
dashboard.role_preview: The system instructions now in use
dashboard.role_scen_help: Pick a case and the asker's language to see how Bayan replies with the current settings (the scope, rules and texts above). The greeting and paused cases need no model; the others really call the model, and the reply may differ each time. The preview is not logged.
dashboard.err_role: A text is longer than {n} characters.
dashboard.err_role_name: The bot name is one to {n} characters on one line.
dashboard.keys_help: Admin only. A key saved here takes precedence over the .env value and works at once, with no restart; it is kept in Bayan's database on the server, and after saving only its last four characters are shown. Every save or clear goes to the action log. The Telegram token and the Meta app secret stay in .env, since changing them needs a restart.
dashboard.flash_key_saved: Key saved and now in use.
dashboard.flash_key_cleared: Key cleared; the .env value is back.
dashboard.err_key: Invalid key: Latin letters, digits and symbols without spaces, at least 8 characters.
dashboard.flash_opp_sent: The week's list is being sent to subscribers on the enabled channels; the result appears here once it is done.
dashboard.need_web: WEB_CHAT_ORIGINS (the site addresses allowed to embed the chat)
dashboard.s_web_help: The chat bubble that the sites in WEB_CHAT_ORIGINS embed with one line: {tag}. Unticked, the bubble disappears from the site and the chat refuses questions.

widget.title: {bot_name} · {org_name}
widget.intro: Hello! I'm {bot_name}, {org_name}'s assistant. I answer only from {org_name}'s published content, in your language. What would you like to know?
widget.error: Something went wrong for a moment. Please try again.
widget.unavailable: The chat is not available right now.
widget.disclaimer: An automated assistant: it can make mistakes, so check the source.
